```{julia}
using DrWatson
@quickactivate "MMc"
using CairoMakie
using CSV
using DataFrames
include(srcdir("simulation.jl"))
using .SimulationModel
```

параметры модели

```{julia}
num_customers = 1000
num_servers = 2

λ = 0.9
μ = 0.5

df = run_simulation(
    num_customers,
    num_servers,
    λ,
    μ
)
```

сохранение результатов

```{julia}
CSV.write(datadir("sims/results.csv"), df)

println(first(df, 5))

fig1 = Figure()

ax1 = Axis(
    fig1[1,1],
    title = "Waiting Time",
    xlabel = "Customer ID",
    ylabel = "Wait Time"
)

lines!(ax1, df.id, df.wait_time)

save(plotsdir("waiting_time.png"), fig1)

fig2 = Figure()

ax2 = Axis(
    fig2[1,1],
    title = "System Time",
    xlabel = "Customer ID",
    ylabel = "Time in System"
)

lines!(ax2, df.id, df.system_time)

save(plotsdir("system_time.png"), fig2)


fig3 = Figure()

ax3 = Axis(
    fig3[1,1],
    title = "Histogram of Waiting Time",
    xlabel = "Wait Time",
    ylabel = "Frequency"
)

hist!(ax3, df.wait_time)

save(plotsdir("wait_histogram.png"), fig3)
```
